datePolicy: Every included URL has an explicit 2026-11-05 research/access record in the fully inspected local source ledger. This is historical record provenance, not a successful fresh fetch or future-price promise. Secondary review dates differ from access dates; source-specific failed follow-up and incomplete coverage remain visible. No external research performed.
uncertainties: Public specs/listings desk research, not a hands-on test; no measured hill, range, braking, water-ingress or comparative performance results created.
March 2027 stock, exact variant price, shipping, gifts, return rights and promotions unknown; modeled starter totals exclude paid assembly and often racks.

Actual carry, inseam, strength, route elevation, weather and work charging unverified. XP Lite2 battery weight conflicts (7 vs 8 lb); LR-specific complete weight unknown. Portola battery-inclusive weight basis and Roadster setup-weight basis unspecified.
Roadster rain caution retained; numeric model IP not verified for Roadster or Soltera. Component IP and published UL claims are not waterproofing or independent certification audits.
Route ranges and yearly costs are judgmental estimates; tariff and replacement-battery reserve not quotes or guarantees. Historical Roadster range concerns an older drivetrain.

Portland rebate income, random selection, March availability, exact product/retailer approval and 2027 thresholds unresolved; no subsidy deducted. State/federal negative findings are bounded and incomplete, not legal/tax determinations.
Recall evidence is a bounded 2026-11-05 title-search result, not a recall-free guarantee; recheck exact bike, components, serial and charger at purchase.
Original run contains only shortlist.html and sources.md, not raw independent webpage captures. All external claims are adapted from those records, not independently reverified.
editingContract: Readable English/Simplified Chinese corresponding lines and table cells retain full numeric, currency, date and URL parity. Draft only; no stars or review schema.
